vectors.label: Nonce Bump
vectors.mechanism: Sends any tx from the maker's address with higher gas priority. The operator's settlement tx arrives with a stale nonce and reverts.
vectors.timing: Must win a ~5 s gas race before settlement mines on Polygon
vectors.impact: Cheapest to execute at scale — exploits the EVM's sequential nonce requirement

vectors.label: Balance Drain
vectors.mechanism: Moves USDC out of the maker's wallet between off-chain match and on-chain settlement. The settlement's transferFrom sees insufficient balance and reverts.
vectors.timing: Drain tx must confirm before the operator's settlement is mined
vectors.cost: 0.001–0.01 POL; attacker recaptures the drained funds
vectors.impact: Maker extracts information value of the fill while keeping capital uncommitted

vectors.label: Allowance Revoke
vectors.mechanism: One approve(ctfExchange, 0) call revokes the allowance the settlement's transferFrom needs. A single on-chain tx is enough.
vectors.timing: Revoke tx races the settlement broadcast — one tx enables all pending fills to ghost
vectors.cost: ~0.0005 POL — cheapest vector to execute at any fill size
vectors.impact: A single approval revocation can ghost an attacker's entire outstanding order book

vectors.label: Proxy Trap
vectors.mechanism: Exploits the contract's proxy upgrade pattern by front-running the settlement's implementation call, routing execution to a revert path.
vectors.timing: Requires mempool visibility and a gas premium; used selectively on high-value fills
vectors.impact: Most sophisticated vector; enables precision reversion of large positions without touching balances
